meta.title: A second bid from the same company is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has an active bid.
steps: The same vendor sends POST /v1/bids again on the same pricing round.
words.expected: The app refuses the second bid (code 99 / 96: one active bid per company), and never with a server error.

plan.title: A second bid from the same company is refused

act.say: The same QA vendor, which already has an active bid on this round, opens a second bid.
